deploy-bot: deploybot: image build finished for canary -> push attempted to registry, signing step failed: manifest rejected (signature expired). env=canary repo=redwood/inference-runtime tag=2026-03-20-rc1 commit=abc123

maria (eng-release): seeing same in pipeline UI. registry says signature timestamp 2024-12-01 (expired)

ken (eng-sre): is this from the signing-proxy key rotation? @olivia did we rotate any KMS keys last night?

olivia (release-manager): we rotated a staging key but not prod. checking rotation logs and KMS events now

zach (eng-runtime): full registry error snippet: ```remote error: manifest invalid: signature_expired: signature timestamp before attestation_valid_from```

maria (eng-release): can we fall back to an unsigned push for canary to unblock validation tests? prefer to avoid if possible

ken (eng-sre): :warning: recommend HOLD on the canary. pin previous canary image `redwood/inference-runtime:2026-03-18-prod-stable` and stop traffic routing to the new tag

olivia (release-manager): ok pinning previous tag and toggling canary off. @deploy-bot please rollback canary routing and mark release state=HOLD

deploy-bot: ack: pin applied -> routing pinned to redwood/inference-runtime:2026-03-18-prod-stable. canary routing disabled. Rollout state: HOLD. incident-tag: sign-expiry-canary-1923456789

maria (eng-release): plan to re-run the signing pipeline after KMS policy confirmed. steps: 1) regenerate ephemeral signing cert 2) cosign sign --key=projects/... 3) push manifest and verify

zach (eng-runtime): quick workaround: I can locally cosign and use skopeo to push the signed manifest as an emergency path, but this will need manual approval + audit note

olivia (release-manager): :thumbsup: manual sign+push acceptable as emergency, coordinate with security. @ken can you own approval?

ken (eng-sre): on it. I'll approve once Maria posts the cosign artifact and key fingerprint. adding a short note to release notes/postmortem about signing expiry and remedial actions

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: manual action requested. Waiting on approvals to re-push signed image and resume canary.
